name: Abbey of St Gall
description: In the Swiss city of St. Gallen, this former Benedictine monastery grew from a hermit's retreat into one of Europe's leading centres of learning. Its Baroque library, rebuilt in the 1700s, holds manuscripts over a thousand years old, including the earliest known architectural plan drawn on parchment. The abbey church is now the town's cathedral, and the city itself grew up around the abbey.
